comment: The mp-tikz-wasm build Clew ships: MetaPost 2.11, pdfTeX, LuaTeX and dvisvgm compiled to WebAssembly, with the TeX bundles their kpathsea reads (74 MB unpacked, ~37 MB as this archive). Unlike the ZetaOffice pins, this one is a VERSIONED GitHub release, so a hash mismatch means the wrong file, not a new upstream build. v0.3.1, published 2026-10-03: opt-in PDF output, a lighter auto.js loader, script-tag prefetch, Node `worker: true`, hot.json kept, and the epstopdf-pkg/grfext/supp-pdf bundles; the engines and the SVG output are unchanged from 0.3.0. Digest and size are the published asset's (GitHub's own sha256), confirmed by scripts/stage-mptikz.js's own download-and-verify on the day of the pin (2026-10-06, staged with MPTIKZ_SRC pointed away from the master so the RELEASE landed). Earlier: v0.3.0, published 2026-09-28: the opt-in `opentype` bundle (fontspec, luaotfload, the Latin Modern faces — what `font=note` needs; `bundles/index.json` lists it, so preview-client/figures.js asks for `+opentype` on marked figures), plain-LuaTeX support and `fonts: 'woff2'`, live custom elements, data-replace, the svg.attributes TikZ library, and chemfig/circuitikz/tikz-3dplot; the engines are unchanged from 0.2.1. A bare tikzcd/circuitikz/\chemfig/\schemestart body is wrapped differently than before, so those figures get new hashes and re-render once. Its digest (4a3a61b3760042d191dbf23d2169a776981be1caad9ec1d2b05cd6729c4d141b, 44,229,933 bytes) was confirmed the same way. Earlier: v0.2.1, published 2026-09-17: spath3 in the bundles, wrapped TikZ figures keeping their standalone border, and the LuaTeX rule fix — every DVI rule (\sqrt, \frac, \hrule …) trapped the wasm module under both LuaTeX formats, a call-arity mismatch in the engine's back-end dispatch table that native C tolerates and WebAssembly does not, fixed by a luatex patch there. Its digest was confirmed the same way (`gh release view v0.2.1 --json assets`). Earlier digests: 2c303539… was a 0.2.1 build before the rule fix, never published; 0.2.0 (a7255429800f196b31a92bdf5dc278c467c32974abb6522a089f041c0955be68) lacked spath3 and cropped classic arrowheads. scripts/stage-mptikz.js prefers the owner's local master build (~/Source/mp-tikz-wasm/dist) and falls back to this archive; dist/ inside it is what lands in mptikz-assets/.
